items.title: Section: The Karmic Fruits Begin — a Vajra-Solid Body, Wondrous Qualities Beyond Comparison, and Supremacy Among Every Kind of Being

items.zh: 此中所有一切施、一切戒，廣說乃至一切同事，若多修習、若善清淨、若具圓滿，能感無上正等菩提金剛堅固身、正法久住果。此中所有難行施、難行戒，廣說乃至難行同事，若多修習、若善清淨、若具圓滿，能感如來成就無等希奇法果。此中所有一切門施、一切門戒，廣說乃至一切門同事，若多修習、若善清淨、若具圓滿，能感如來一切最勝有情天人所供養果。此中所有善士施、善士戒，廣說乃至善士同事，若多修習、若善清淨、若具圓滿，能感如來於諸有情無足、二足、四足、多足、有色、無色、有想、無想及以非想非非想處，於此一切有情類中最尊勝果。
items.en: All generosity, all discipline, and, in full detail, all working alongside others — when widely practised, well purified, and fully complete — ripen into supreme, complete awakening's own vajra-solid body, and into the lasting endurance of the true teaching in the world. Difficult-practice generosity, difficult-practice discipline, and, in full detail, difficult-practice working alongside others — when widely practised, well purified, and fully complete — ripen into the Tathāgata's own matchless, wondrous qualities found nowhere else. Comprehensive-gateway generosity, comprehensive-gateway discipline, and, in full detail, comprehensive-gateway working alongside others — when widely practised, well purified, and fully complete — ripen into the Tathāgata's own supremacy, worthy of offerings from every excellent being, human and celestial alike. Virtuous-person generosity, virtuous-person discipline, and, in full detail, virtuous-person working alongside others — when widely practised, well purified, and fully complete — ripen into the Tathāgata's own supremacy among literally every kind of being: footless, two-footed, four-footed, many-footed; possessing form or formless; possessing perception, lacking perception, or dwelling in neither perception nor non-perception — supreme among every single one of these categories of being.

items.title: Section: The Final Fruits — the Marks of a Great Being, Invincibility at the Bodhi Seat, and Every Unique Quality of a Buddha — Fascicle 43 Closes

items.zh: 此中所有一切種施、一切種戒，廣說乃至一切種同事，若多修習、若善清淨、若具圓滿，能感如來無量殊勝福德所攝三十有二大丈夫相、八十隨好莊嚴身果。此中所有遂求施、遂求戒，廣說乃至遂求同事，若多修習、若善清淨、若具圓滿，能感如來坐菩提座，一切魔怨不能惱觸、不傾動果。此中所有此世他世樂施、此世他世樂戒，廣說乃至此世他世樂同事，若多修習、若善清淨、若具圓滿，能感如來最勝靜慮、解脫、等持、等至樂果。此中所有清淨施、清淨戒，廣說乃至清淨同事，若多修習、若善清淨、若具圓滿，能感如來四一切種清淨果。謂所依淨、所緣淨、心淨、智淨。亦感如來三不護、十力、四無所畏、三念住、一切不共佛法極清淨果。如是菩薩施等善法，能感無上到究竟果，當知亦感生死流轉順菩薩行所餘無量無邊可愛無罪勝果。
items.en: Comprehensive-kind generosity, comprehensive-kind discipline, and, in full detail, comprehensive-kind working alongside others — when widely practised, well purified, and fully complete — ripen into the Tathāgata's own immeasurable, supremely meritorious thirty-two major marks and eighty minor marks adorning the body. Fulfilling-requests generosity, fulfilling-requests discipline, and, in full detail, fulfilling-requests working alongside others — when widely practised, well purified, and fully complete — ripen into the Tathāgata sitting at the seat of awakening entirely unshaken and untroubled by any hostile force whatsoever. Both-worlds-happiness generosity, both-worlds-happiness discipline, and, in full detail, both-worlds-happiness working alongside others — when widely practised, well purified, and fully complete — ripen into the Tathāgata's own supreme bliss of meditative absorption, liberation, concentration, and attainment. Purity generosity, purity discipline, and, in full detail, purity working alongside others — when widely practised, well purified, and fully complete — ripen into the Tathāgata's own four complete purities: purity of basis, purity of object, purity of mind, and purity of wisdom; and likewise into the Tathāgata's freedom from ever needing to guard body, speech, or mind, the ten powers, the four fearlessnesses, the three foundations of mindfulness, and the complete, utterly pure fruit of every quality shared with no other being. In this way, a bodhisattva's practice of generosity and the rest ripens into the ultimate, complete fruit of awakening itself; one should also understand that it ripens, throughout the bodhisattva's own continued journey through birth and death in accordance with bodhisattva conduct, into countless further genuinely excellent and blameless fruits besides.

blocks.text: A short day: what the perfections and means of embracing ripen into. Fascicle 43 ends today.

"All generosity, all discipline, through all working alongside others, when widely practised, purified, and complete, ripen into supreme awakening's vajra-solid body, and into the long endurance of the true teaching." Venerable Miào Jìng explains the vajra body.

subs.head: The marks of a great being

blocks.text: Each kind of practice ripens into a particular fruit: the thirty-two marks of a great being, invincibility at the seat of awakening, and every quality unique to a Buddha.

With this, all six perfections and the four means of embracing have been laid out in the same nine-part frame. The frame can seem repetitive, but its point is that every virtue has a nature, a scope, a difficult form, a good person's form, and a pure form, and the bodhisattva cultivates all of them. Fascicle 44 continues the Bodhisattva Stage with the chapters on offering, reliance on teachers, and the immeasurables.

quiz.q: All generosity through all working-alongside ripen into "the vajra-solid body of awakening." What does Venerable Miào Jìng say this body is?
quiz.why: "Ripen into supreme awakening's own vajra-solid body, and the lasting endurance of the true teaching." Venerable Miào Jìng: this vajra-solid body should refer to the body of self-enjoyment; the vajra-like samādhi is the last moment of the near-perfect bodhisattva.
